author: @adrian.factfinder
top_level_effects: Buffer builtin import; two numeric constants, one private Symbol and one fixed string; synchronous function declarations only

validateUtf8: indexed bytes and finite bounded loops

manual_findings: Full exact production source inspected: no fs/network/env/process/timer/promise/callback/async/native/require/eval/dynamic import or application-wrapper route; no input-dependent code execution. Only synchronous data parsing. Supplementary regex is not sole admission proof.
limits: Authored manual audit, not formal static analysis or hostile runtime sandbox. Builtin monkeypatches/native internals can invalidate normal-runtime assumptions.
data_url_semantics: Harness first evaluates exact pinned leaf bytes from data URL after hooks, with optional node:buffer import only. No relative imports or import.meta makes file-location behavior differ.
